content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the sample. We need to infer from NMR data perhaps. We can request proton NMR spectra (which will show methyl signals). Or carbon NMR to see methyl carbons. Use minimal experiments. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count methyl peaks (triplet etc). But we need to know number of distinct CH3 groups? Usually question: "How many CH3 groups in the sample's compound?" Means count of methyl groups (could be equivalent). Use proton NMR to see number of methyl signals. Could also use carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons. Let's request proton NMR.
